# Bundled third-party software

These files are copied unmodified from their official npm packages so MDoP works without internet access.

| Folder | Project | Version | License |
|---|---|---|---|
| `wavesurfer/` | [wavesurfer.js](https://github.com/katspaugh/wavesurfer.js) (core + regions, timeline, minimap, hover plugins) | 7.12.12 | BSD-3-Clause (`wavesurfer/LICENSE`) |
| `alphatab/` | [alphaTab](https://github.com/CoderLine/alphaTab) | 1.9.0 | MPL-2.0 (`alphatab/LICENSE`) |
| `alphatab/font/` | Bravura music font (SMuFL) | from alphaTab 1.9.0 | SIL Open Font License 1.1 (`alphatab/font/Bravura-OFL.txt`) |
| `alphatab/soundfont/` | Sonivox General MIDI sound bank | from alphaTab 1.9.0 | Apache-2.0 (`alphatab/soundfont/LICENSE`) |

The source code of alphaTab is available at https://github.com/CoderLine/alphaTab.
